definition: Official completions. Official nflverse box-score total.
Passing touchdowns per pass attempt.
Official pass attempts. Official nflverse box-score total. Spikes count; sacks do not.
Official passing yards. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official passing touchdowns. Official nflverse box-score total.
Official completions per official pass attempt.

Completion percentage over expected (CPOE): his completions minus the completion probability nflfastR's model gave each attempt, in percentage points, pooled over every attempt that has a probability (throwaways and spikes have none).
Official passing yards per official pass attempt (sacks excluded).
How far downfield his passes travel on average, completed or not: official passing air yards per attempt.
Average time from the snap to the throw on his pass attempts (sacks excluded), from the Next Gen Stats regular-season summary.
Share of his dropbacks (pass attempts and sacks, as play-by-play flags them) with positive expected points added. EPA > 0, not a down-and-distance rule.

Expected points added per dropback: nflverse's passing EPA (which credits the quarterback up to a receiver's fumble) over pass attempts plus sacks. Scrambles are not included. The same definition as the card's in-season usage reading.
Sacks taken per dropback (pass attempts plus sacks).
Interceptions thrown per pass attempt.
Rushes he carried inside the opponent's 5-yard line (sneaks included).
Official rushing touchdowns. Official nflverse box-score total.
Share of his dropbacks, scrambles included, that became scrambles.
Pass attempts and sacks he had inside the opponent's 20-yard line.
Runs he carried that were not scrambles: rush attempts with no scramble flag, kneel-downs and two-point tries excluded. nflverse has no designed-run flag; this is the derivation.
Dropbacks he turned into runs, as nflverse flags them (qb_scramble).
Official rushing yards, kneel-downs included. Official nflverse box-score total.
Rushes he carried inside the opponent's 20-yard line, designed runs and scrambles alike; kneel-downs and two-point tries excluded.
His 40-yard dash time at the NFL Scouting Combine, in the year he tested, ranked among every tester at the same combine position since 2000 with a recorded time (faster ranks first).
A game played is a regular-season week with a weekly stats row or at least one offensive snap (the usage layer's and season actuals' definition).

nflfastR's completion model, not Next Gen Stats'. Pooled over attempts, not the average of weekly values (which differ by up to 34 points). Includes incomplete passes and throwaways (official air yards).
Only for passers Next Gen Stats qualifies, and only when its season summary matches his official attempts through the cutoff.

Same plays as EPA per dropback; success uses each play's own EPA. Efficiency rates are noisy early in a season: in 2023-2025 the weeks 1-5 rate of this kind related only weakly to the rest of the same season (EDA 2026-10-14). It describes his games so far, not what comes next.

Interceptions are rare: in 2023-2025 a weeks 1-5 interception rate did not anticipate the rest of the season at all (EDA 2026-10-14).
Very small counts; one drive can change it.
